photoobj_core.name: photoobj_core
photoobj_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.u,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  -- Normalize clean: prefer non-null integer; coerce truthy values to 1, else 0.
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.clean, 0)::integer, 0) AS clean
FROM
  photoobj p
photoobj_core.description: Canonical per-photometric-object projection with key positional and photometric columns, cleaned/canonicalized for joins (no question-specific filters).

specobj_core.name: specobj_core
specobj_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.class,
  s.z,
  s.zerr,
  s.ra,
  s.dec,
  s.plate,
  s.mjd,
  s.fiberid
FROM specobj AS s
specobj_core.description: Canonical per-spectroscopic-object projection with key spectroscopic identifiers, classification and redshift, prepared for joining to photometric objects via bestobjid.

photo_spec_join.name: photo_spec_join
photo_spec_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra     AS photo_ra,
  p.dec    AS photo_dec,
  p.g      AS g,
  s.specobjid AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid AS bestobjid,
  s.class     AS spec_class,
  s.z         AS spec_z
FROM photoobj p
JOIN specobj s
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
photo_spec_join.description: Denormalized one-row-per-photometric-object that has an associated spectroscopic record via specobj.bestobjid; combines core photoobj and specobj fields useful for filtering by spectroscopic classification and redshift.
